title: 3dinfo
description: Prints out sort-of-useful information from a 3D dataset's header

orient.description: Value of orientation string. For example, LPI means: i direction grows from Left(negative) to Right(positive). j direction grows from Posterior (neg.) to Anterior (pos.) k direction grows from Inferior (neg.) to Superior (pos.)
orient.title: Orientation

all_names.description: Value of various dset structures handling filenames
all_names.title: All Names

very_verbose.description: Print out even more information including slice time offsets
very_verbose.title: Very Verbose

h_find.description: Look for lines in help output that match WORD
h_find.title: Help Find

h_spx.description: Help string in sphinx format without autoformatting options
h_spx.title: Help SPX

h_aspx.description: Help string in sphinx format with autoformatting options
h_aspx.title: Help ASPX

all_opts.description: Try to identify all options for the program from the help output
all_opts.title: All Options

subbrick_info.description: Output only sub-brick part of information
subbrick_info.title: Sub-brick Info

exists.description: 1 if dset is loadable, 0 otherwise. This works on prefix also.
exists.title: Exists

is_atlas_or_labeltable.description: 1 if dset has an atlas or labeltable.
is_atlas_or_labeltable.title: Is Atlas or Labeltable

is_nifti.description: 1 if dset is NIFTI format, 0 otherwise
is_nifti.title: Is NIFTI

dset_extension.description: Show filename extension for valid dataset (e.g. .nii.gz)
dset_extension.title: Dataset Extension

storage_mode.description: Show internal storage mode of dataset (e.g. NIFTI)
storage_mode.title: Storage Mode

av_space.description: AFNI format's view extension for the space
av_space.title: AFNI View Space

nifti_code.description: What AFNI would use for an output NIFTI (q)sform_code
nifti_code.title: NIFTI Code

handedness.description: L if orientation is Left handed, R if it is right handed
handedness.title: Handedness

obliquity.description: Angle from plumb direction. Angles of 0 (or close) are for cardinal orientations
obliquity.title: Obliquity

ni.description: Return the number of voxels in i dimension
ni.title: Number of Voxels in i

nj.description: Return the number of voxels in j dimension
nj.title: Number of Voxels in j

nk.description: Return the number of voxels in k dimension
nk.title: Number of Voxels in k

nv.description: Return number of points in time or the number of sub-bricks
nv.title: Number of Points in Time

n4.title: Number of Voxels in i*j*k and Points in Time

ntimes.description: Return number of sub-bricks points in time. This is an option for debugging use, stay away from it.
ntimes.title: Number of Sub-bricks Points in Time

max_node.description: For a surface-based dset, return the maximum node index
max_node.title: Maximum Node Index

di.description: Signed displacement per voxel along i direction, aka dx
di.title: Displacement in i

dj.description: Signed displacement per voxel along j direction, aka dy
dj.title: Displacement in j

dk.description: Signed displacement per voxel along k direction, aka dz
dk.title: Displacement in k

ad3.title: Voxel Size in i, j, k

oi.description: Volume origin along the i direction
oi.title: Origin in i

oj.description: Volume origin along the j direction
oj.title: Origin in j

ok.description: Volume origin along the k direction
ok.title: Origin in k

dcx.description: Volumetric center in x direction (DICOM coordinates)
dcx.title: Center in x

dcy.description: Volumetric center in y direction (DICOM coordinates)
dcy.title: Center in y

dcz.description: Volumetric center in z direction (DICOM coordinates)
dcz.title: Center in z

dmin.description: The dataset's minimum value, scaled by fac
dmin.title: Minimum Value (Scaled)

dmax.description: The dataset's maximum value, scaled by fac
dmax.title: Maximum Value (Scaled)

iname.description: Name of dset as input on the command line
iname.title: Input Name

extent.description: The spatial extent of the dataset along R, L, A, P, I and S
extent.title: Spatial Extent

min.description: The minimum value, scaled by fac
min.title: Minimum Value (Scaled)

max.description: The maximum value, scaled by fac
max.title: Maximum Value (Scaled)

labeltable_as_atlas_points.description: Show label table in atlas point format
labeltable_as_atlas_points.title: Label Table as Atlas Points

atlas_points.description: Show atlas points list, if any
atlas_points.title: Atlas Points

header_line.description: Output as the first line the names of attributes in each field (column)
header_line.title: Header Line

sb_delim.description: Delimiter string between sub-brick values. Default SB_DELIM is '|'
sb_delim.title: Sub-brick Delimiter

NA_flag.description: String to use when a field is not found or not applicable. Default is 'NA'
NA_flag.title: NA Flag

atr_delim.description: Delimiter string between attributes. Default ATR_DELIM is the tab character
atr_delim.title: Attribute Delimiter

aform_real.description: Display full 3x4 'aform_real' matrix (AFNI's RAI equivalent of the sform matrix in NIFTI, may contain obliquity info), with comment line first
aform_real.title: Aform Real Matrix

aform_real_oneline.description: Display full 'aform_real' matrix (see '-aform_real') as 1 row of 12 numbers. No additional comment
aform_real_oneline.title: Aform Real Matrix (One Line)

aform_real_refit_ori.description: Display full 3x4 'aform_real' matrix (see '-aform_real') *if* the dset were reoriented (via 3drefit) to new orient XXX. Includes comment line first
aform_real_refit_ori.title: Aform Real Matrix (Refit Orientation)

is_aform_real_orth.description: If true, aform_real == aform_orth, which should be a very common occurrence
is_aform_real_orth.title: Is Aform Real Orthogonal

aform_orth.description: Display full 3x4 'aform_orth' matrix (AFNI's RAI matrix equivalent of the NIFTI quaternion, which may contain obliquity info), with comment line first. This matrix is the orthogonalized form of aform_real, and very often AFNI-produced dsets, we will have: aform_orth == aform_real
aform_orth.title: Aform Orthogonal Matrix

perm_to_orient.description: Display 3x3 permutation matrix to go from the dset's current orientation to the YYY orient
perm_to_orient.title: Permutation to Orientation

same_grid.description: Output 1 if the grid is identical between two dsets, 0 otherwise. For -same_grid to be 1, all of -same_dim, -same_delta, -same_orient, -same_center, and -same_obl must return 1
same_grid.title: Same Grid

same_dim.description: 1 if dimensions (nx, ny, nz) are the same between dset pairs
same_dim.title: Same Dimensions

same_delta.description: 1 if voxel sizes are the same between dset pairs
same_delta.title: Same Voxel Sizes

same_orient.description: 1 if orientation is the same between dset pairs
same_orient.title: Same Orientation

same_center.description: 1 if geometric center is the same between dset pairs
same_center.title: Same Geometric Center

same_obl.description: 1 if obliquity is the same between dset pairs
same_obl.title: Same Obliquity

same_all_grid.description: Equivalent to listing all of -same_dim, -same_delta, -same_orient, -same_center, and -same_obl on the command line
same_all_grid.title: Same All Grid

val_diff.description: Output the sum of absolute differences of all voxels in the dataset pair. A -1.0 value indicates a grid mismatch between volume pairs
val_diff.title: Value Difference

sval_diff.description: Same as -val_diff, but the sum is divided (scaled) by the total number of voxels that are not zero in at least one of the two datasets
sval_diff.title: Scaled Value Difference

monog_pairs.description: Instead of pairing each dset with the first, pair each couple separately. This requires you to have an even number of dsets on the command line
monog_pairs.title: Monogamous Pairs
